destinations.name: Victoria Falls
destinations.description: Waterfall viewpoints, Zambezi cruises and gorge adventures around Zimbabwe’s best-known waterfall town.
destinations.planning: Ask each operator about transfers, park fees and seasonal river conditions before booking.
destinations.ecoTip: Use designated routes, take litter home, and follow local guides and site rules. Ask permission before photographing people.

destinations.name: Matobo Hills
destinations.description: Granite hills south of Bulawayo, rock-art sites and guided rhino tracking.
destinations.planning: Arrange guided wildlife activities in advance and confirm which park and heritage fees are included.
destinations.ecoTip: Use designated routes, take litter home, and follow local guides and site rules. Ask permission before photographing people.

destinations.name: Hwange National Park
destinations.description: Explore Zimbabwe’s western safari country through game drives, walking safaris and time at waterholes.
destinations.planning: Choose a camp or park entrance before arranging transport. Activities and access vary by camp and concession.
destinations.ecoTip: Use designated routes, take litter home, and follow local guides and site rules. Ask permission before photographing people.

destinations.name: Chinhoyi Caves
destinations.description: A cave system near Chinhoyi known for the deep blue Sleeping Pool.
destinations.planning: Check access and opening arrangements with ZimParks. Viewing the caves and specialist diving require different arrangements.
destinations.ecoTip: Use designated routes, take litter home, and follow local guides and site rules. Ask permission before photographing people.

destinations.name: Nyanga & Mutarazi Falls
destinations.description: Eastern Highlands landscapes, mountain walks and the Mutarazi Falls SkyWalk and SkyLine.
destinations.planning: Check mountain conditions and activity requirements directly. Allow time for the approach roads to the falls.
destinations.ecoTip: Use designated routes, take litter home, and follow local guides and site rules. Ask permission before photographing people.

destinations.name: Chimanimani National Park
destinations.description: Mountain wilderness in Zimbabwe’s Eastern Highlands, with hiking routes through rugged scenery.
destinations.planning: Arrange your route, guide, permits and overnight plans with the park before setting out.
destinations.ecoTip: Use designated routes, take litter home, and follow local guides and site rules. Ask permission before photographing people.

destinations.name: Great Zimbabwe
destinations.description: The stone-built remains of a major historic Shona settlement, including the Hill Complex and Great Enclosure.
destinations.planning: Ask the monument authority about opening hours, admission and on-site guiding.
destinations.ecoTip: Use designated routes, take litter home, and follow local guides and site rules. Ask permission before photographing people.

destinations.name: Khami Ruins
destinations.description: A heritage site near Bulawayo with decorated stone walls and terraces from the Kingdom of Butua.
destinations.planning: Plan a visit from Bulawayo and check current access and guiding with the monument authority.
destinations.ecoTip: Use designated routes, take litter home, and follow local guides and site rules. Ask permission before photographing people.

destinations.name: Mana Pools National Park
destinations.description: Zambezi river scenery and safari experiences on foot, by vehicle and by canoe with specialist operators.
destinations.planning: Confirm seasonal camp access, transfers and the operator’s requirements for walking or canoeing.
destinations.ecoTip: Use designated routes, take litter home, and follow local guides and site rules. Ask permission before photographing people.

destinations.name: Gonarezhou National Park
destinations.description: Lowveld wilderness, scenic viewpoints and wildlife routes around the Runde and Mwenezi river landscapes.
destinations.planning: Discuss your route, vehicle and accommodation with the park. Check conditions before remote travel.
destinations.ecoTip: Use designated routes, take litter home, and follow local guides and site rules. Ask permission before photographing people.

destinations.name: Lake Kariba
destinations.description: Lakeside scenery and opportunities to plan time on the water from Kariba.
destinations.planning: Ask the park or your chosen operator about boating arrangements, permits and current lake conditions.
destinations.ecoTip: Use designated routes, take litter home, and follow local guides and site rules. Ask permission before photographing people.

destinations.name: Matusadona National Park
destinations.description: A remote safari landscape along Lake Kariba, with woodland, hills and lakeshore wildlife viewing.
destinations.planning: Plan access and accommodation with the park; ask about road conditions and boat-transfer options.
destinations.ecoTip: Use designated routes, take litter home, and follow local guides and site rules. Ask permission before photographing people.
